pieces.Text: 1/day, you can open your soul to a demonic spirit as a free action. This spirit possesses you for
bonus to an ability score of your choice. When the energumen ends, you become confused for

Energumen is a possession effect and is negated by protection from evil or protection from chaos. Being affected by such a spell prevents both the benefits and the confusion.
